nonclaims: A clean scan proves only absence of the exact preregistered token bytes from the content and relative pathnames of the exact retained regular files in scope; it does not prove memory erasure, semantic forgetting, tool denial, or noninterference.

The scan covers file contents and relative pathnames for every retained regular file under the preregistered cell tree, including cooperative locks; it cannot inspect empty-directory names, provider memory, unretained prompts, private transport logs, artifacts outside that tree, or covert channels.
A provider or worker may transform, paraphrase, summarize, or use private information without reproducing the exact canary.
A detected match does not identify the provider mechanism that caused it and does not automatically invalidate or exclude a cell.
The complete driver is private coordinator context and is not an appropriate nested role-worker or blind-rater prompt.
Passing schemas, audits, receipts, scans, and bundle seals do not prove narrative quality, model identity, rater independence, or retcon-planning efficacy.
Database schema 8 and event schema 1 remain unchanged; contamination plans/scans and bundle evidence are private host/exchange artifacts.
acceptance_note: Rev0165 turns a central context-window and shared-filesystem confound into a preregistered exact-token negative control whose result is frozen before rating, retained through unblinding, and bound into replicated block evidence without changing ordinary play.
